text:
Nora (PM): quick sync: we need a compact rollout for the 'cohort-hedge' plan (redundant-model routing + per-tenant opt-out). aim: small alpha, then regional ramp with fast fallback.
Dev (Eng): proposal: two-phase. Phase A: shadow 15% globally for 48h to collect quality + cost. Phase B: visible opt-in cohorts in NA at 5% -> 20% -> 80%. routing rule: prefer low-latency pool, if health failing then route to baseline or quantized fallback.
Iris (SRE): infra guardrails: dedicate canary pool in us-east with warmed KV and persistent hot cache. Alarms: sustained p99 > 300ms OR 5xx rate > 0.6% for 10m -> trigger auto-fallback and page. Add per-tenant kill switch and audit entry.
Cal (Data): metrics: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization, token cost delta, quality delta measured on seeded eval set. I'll provide a sheared eval bundle and dashboard panels (lift, CI, cohort counts). Need ~12k samples per arm to detect 1.2% quality shift.
Nora (PM): launch gates: smoke (5% visible) must show no infra alarms and quality delta <=1.2%. Manual check at 20%. Full roll only with sign-off and runbook in #launchroom.
Dev (Eng): flag proto for ops team (json blob pasted to ops repo):
```json
{"flag":"cohort_hedge_v1","mode":"opt_in","variants":[{"name":"baseline","ratio":0.95},{"name":"hedge","ratio":0.05}],"regions":["NA","EU","APAC"],"fallbacks":["baseline","quantized_fallback"],"kill_switch":"global_off"}
```
Iris (SRE): add an automated fallback path that first tries quantized_fallback for 2 minutes, if that fails route to baseline. Also attach a traffic shedder to maintain p99 < 400ms under burst.
ops-bot: scheduled shadow-run: 2026-06-04T01:00Z, visible-start: 2026-06-06T14:00Z
Cal (Data): will ship the eval set and dashboard by EOD Tue.
Nora (PM): enterprise ask: BigCorp wants EU-only and a per-tenant SLA guard (no visible changes without pre-approval). We'll add tenant metadata to the flag and an audit trail for approvals.
Iris (SRE): noted. I'll add per-tenant approval gating and an explicit maintenance-window hook that disables visible splits during scheduled windows.
Dev (Eng): action items: implement shadow routing + flag schema, add fallback switch in runtime. Iris: alarms + per-tenant killpath. Cal: eval dashboard. Nora: customer comms + runbook.
Nora (PM): target soft launch week of 2026-06-08. Any blockers?
Dev (Eng): none from eng.
Iris (SRE): will finalize alarms and schedule a 20m pre-canary review.
Cal (Data): dashboard PR out shortly.
Nora (PM): thanks all — I'll post runbook in #launchroom and ping owners when PRs merge.
